# iedc fixtures

Retrieved 2026-09-28 from the Invisible East Digital Corpus XML
dataset, Zenodo doi 10.5281/zenodo.20490276 (v1.1, file
iedc_2026-06-01_14-07.xml, 6.55 MB, CC BY 4.0) — four representative
<item> records extracted verbatim:

- IEDC0382 · Khotanese (Brahmi script) — a METADATA-ONLY catalog
  record (no folios text; the 552-strong Khotanese slice is largely
  this shape — its text lane is the Skjaervø BL set, a separate
  source).
- IEDC0201 · New Persian (Arabic script) — folio transcription as
  EMBEDDED HTML (<ol><li> per line) + a typed dates string with the
  parenthesized ISO substring ("… (1183-10)" shape).
- IEDC0002 · Bactrian (Greek-based script) — transcription + dates.
- IEDC1266 · Middle Persian (Pahlavi script) — a folio carrying BOTH
  transcription and transliteration (transcription wins; no
  transliteration-only folio exists in v1.1 — censused 2026-09-28).

Live census 2026-09-28: 1,316 top-level items (the survey's 4,801 was
a nested-tag overcount); 481 carry transcription text
(transliterations only ever accompany them); translations 283 (declared residue, not served
v1); dates typed on 317; toponyms lists carry name/lat/long fields.
